questionSetLabel: MVP demonstration question set. Questions should be reviewed and expanded before being presented as a finalized methodology.

categories.name: Cybersecurity
categories.shortDescription: Protection against common security threats and business disruption.
categories.businessExplanation: Cybersecurity health reflects how well the business protects sensitive data, accounts, devices, and systems from preventable compromise.

categories.name: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
categories.shortDescription: Ability to keep operating through outages, data loss, and vendor failures.
categories.businessExplanation: Continuity planning determines whether the business can recover critical systems quickly enough to avoid unacceptable revenue, service, or reputation damage.

categories.name: Identity and Access Management
categories.shortDescription: Controls for who can access business systems and administrative tools.
categories.businessExplanation: Access management reduces the chance that a lost password, former employee account, or shared administrator login becomes a business incident.

categories.name: Technology Operations
categories.shortDescription: Day-to-day reliability, ownership, documentation, monitoring, and support.
categories.businessExplanation: Operations health shows whether technology issues are handled predictably or depend on heroics and undocumented knowledge.

categories.name: Productivity and Collaboration
categories.shortDescription: How effectively teams use communication, document, and workflow tools.
categories.businessExplanation: Collaboration health indicates whether tools make work faster and clearer or create duplicated effort and information silos.

categories.name: Cloud and Infrastructure
categories.shortDescription: Reliability, maintainability, and security of hosting and core infrastructure.
categories.businessExplanation: Infrastructure health reflects whether the systems running the business are understandable, supportable, secure, and resilient.

categories.name: Governance and Risk Management
categories.shortDescription: Decision ownership, policies, vendor accountability, and risk visibility.
categories.businessExplanation: Governance health shows whether leaders can see technology risk clearly and make informed investment decisions.

categories.name: AI Readiness
categories.shortDescription: Preparedness to use AI tools safely, productively, and responsibly.
categories.businessExplanation: AI readiness measures whether the business can capture productivity gains without exposing sensitive data or creating unmanaged risk.

categories.name: Cost Optimization
categories.shortDescription: Visibility and control over software, cloud, and vendor spend.
categories.businessExplanation: Cost health indicates whether technology spending is intentional, reviewed, and tied to business value.

categories.name: Vendor and Technology Strategy
categories.shortDescription: Fit, ownership, and lifecycle planning for key vendors and platforms.
categories.businessExplanation: Technology strategy health shows whether vendor decisions support the business or create avoidable lock-in, fragility, or duplicated tools.

questions.prompt: Are administrators required to use multi-factor authentication when accessing critical systems?
questions.description: Include cloud consoles, email administration, finance systems, and remote access tools.
questions.businessImpact: Administrator accounts are high-value targets. Missing MFA can turn one stolen password into a business-wide incident.

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown admin MFA status indicates limited security visibility.

criticalFindingRule.findingTitle: Administrative accounts are not protected by MFA

recommendation.title: Require MFA for administrative access
recommendation.action: Enable MFA for all administrative accounts and review exceptions monthly.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces the likelihood that a stolen password becomes a major incident.

questions.prompt: How consistently are laptops, servers, and business devices patched?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown patch status may indicate unmanaged exposure.

recommendation.title: Create a patch management routine
recommendation.action: Define patch ownership, cadence, reporting, and exception handling for critical devices.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces exposure to known vulnerabilities and avoids emergency remediation.

questions.prompt: When was the last successful test of restoring critical business data from backup?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown restore history should be treated as a serious recovery risk.

criticalFindingRule.findingTitle: Critical business data does not have tested backups

recommendation.title: Test backup restoration
recommendation.action: Run and document a restore test for critical systems, then schedule recurring tests.
recommendation.businessImpact: Confirms the business can recover data before an outage or ransomware event forces the issue.

questions.prompt: Is there a named owner and written recovery process for your most critical systems?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown ownership can slow recovery during an incident.

recommendation.title: Document recovery ownership
recommendation.action: Assign recovery owners and capture the first-hour recovery checklist for critical systems.
recommendation.businessImpact: Improves decision speed and accountability during outages.

questions.prompt: How quickly are former employees and contractors removed from business systems?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown offboarding status is an access governance risk.

criticalFindingRule.findingTitle: Former employees or contractors may retain access

recommendation.title: Tighten access offboarding
recommendation.action: Create a same-day offboarding checklist for email, productivity, finance, cloud, and line-of-business systems.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces insider and account takeover risk after role changes or departures.

questions.prompt: Do people use shared administrator accounts for important systems?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown shared-account use weakens accountability.

criticalFindingRule.findingTitle: Shared administrator accounts are in use

recommendation.title: Eliminate shared administrator accounts
recommendation.action: Move administrators to named accounts and retain emergency access separately.
recommendation.businessImpact: Improves accountability and reduces broad password-sharing risk.

questions.prompt: Does the business maintain a current list of important systems, owners, and support contacts?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown ownership increases operational risk.

recommendation.title: Create a critical systems inventory
recommendation.action: Document key systems, owners, vendors, renewal dates, and support paths.
recommendation.businessImpact: Makes outages, vendor changes, and audits easier to manage.

questions.prompt: After meaningful outages or technology incidents, does the team review what happened and assign follow-up actions?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown review practice suggests inconsistent learning.

recommendation.title: Run lightweight incident reviews
recommendation.action: Create a short review process for causes, impact, customer communication, and prevention actions.
recommendation.businessImpact: Turns recurring problems into managed improvement work.

questions.prompt: Can staff reliably find the current version of important documents and policies?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown document ownership may indicate collaboration friction.

recommendation.title: Clarify document ownership
recommendation.action: Define where official documents live, who owns them, and how obsolete copies are handled.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces rework, confusion, and policy drift.

questions.prompt: Is external file sharing reviewed or restricted for sensitive information?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown external sharing settings may expose sensitive files.

recommendation.title: Review external sharing controls
recommendation.action: Set sharing defaults, review public links, and define sensitive-data sharing rules.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces accidental disclosure through collaboration tools.

questions.prompt: Is there a clearly identifiable owner for core domains, DNS, cloud accounts, and hosting?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown ownership of core accounts is a serious business continuity risk.

criticalFindingRule.findingTitle: No identifiable owner for core domains or cloud accounts

recommendation.title: Confirm ownership of core infrastructure accounts
recommendation.action: Document account owners, recovery contacts, MFA status, and billing ownership for domains, DNS, cloud, and hosting.
recommendation.businessImpact: Prevents avoidable lockout, downtime, and vendor escalation delays.

questions.prompt: Are internet-facing servers and services reviewed for unsupported software or unnecessary exposure?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown exposure can hide high-risk infrastructure.

recommendation.title: Review internet-facing infrastructure
recommendation.action: Inventory public services, remove unnecessary exposure, and patch or replace unsupported systems.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces the risk of preventable compromise through exposed infrastructure.

questions.prompt: Do leaders maintain a simple list of known technology risks and planned actions?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown risk ownership limits executive visibility.

recommendation.title: Create a technology risk register
recommendation.action: Track material risks, owners, likely impact, and next actions in a leadership-reviewed list.
recommendation.businessImpact: Helps leaders prioritize technology investment based on business risk.

questions.prompt: Are key technology policies reviewed at least annually?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown policy review cadence suggests governance drift.

recommendation.title: Review core technology policies
recommendation.action: Schedule an annual review of security, access, acceptable use, backup, and vendor policies.
recommendation.businessImpact: Keeps expectations current as the business changes.

questions.prompt: Has the business told employees what company or customer data may be used with AI tools?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown AI data rules create preventable confidentiality risk.

recommendation.title: Define AI data-use rules
recommendation.action: Publish practical guidance for what data can and cannot be entered into AI tools.
recommendation.businessImpact: Allows productivity gains while reducing confidentiality and contractual risk.

questions.prompt: Are approved AI tools and use cases documented for employees?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown AI usage can lead to unmanaged shadow tools.

recommendation.title: Create an approved AI tool list
recommendation.action: Identify approved AI tools, acceptable use cases, and escalation paths for new use cases.
recommendation.businessImpact: Improves adoption while reducing shadow technology risk.

questions.prompt: How often does the business review software subscriptions for unused licenses or duplicate tools?

options.label: Routinely with owners and usage data

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown subscription usage may indicate overspending.

recommendation.title: Review recurring software spend
recommendation.action: Compare subscriptions, owners, usage, and renewal dates at least quarterly.
recommendation.businessImpact: Reduces waste and improves budgeting visibility.

questions.prompt: Are cloud or hosting costs monitored against budgets or expected usage?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown cloud spending controls may hide waste.

recommendation.title: Set cloud cost visibility
recommendation.action: Add budget alerts, ownership tags, and recurring cost review for cloud and hosting spend.
recommendation.businessImpact: Prevents surprise bills and connects infrastructure spend to business value.

questions.prompt: Are critical technology vendors reviewed for fit, risk, support quality, and renewal terms?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown vendor review cadence can create renewal and lock-in risk.

recommendation.title: Review critical vendors
recommendation.action: Create a short annual review for critical vendors covering cost, fit, risk, support, and renewal terms.
recommendation.businessImpact: Improves leverage and reduces avoidable vendor dependency.

questions.prompt: Is there a simple technology roadmap tied to business priorities?

unknownBehavior.note: Unknown roadmap alignment may indicate reactive technology spending.

recommendation.title: Create a pragmatic technology roadmap
recommendation.action: Map the next 6-12 months of technology work to business outcomes, risks, and dependencies.
recommendation.businessImpact: Helps technology investment support business priorities instead of reacting to the loudest issue.
